newsitem.title: BRAZIL: TAM soars on report of stake purchase.
newsitem.headline: TAM soars on report of stake purchase.

text.p: Preferred shares of Brazilian airline TAM soared 9.6 percent on reports that four private equity funds have bought a 22.9 percent stake in the firm for 80 million reais ($75 million).

The stock surged to 68.51 reais by 1118 local time/1018 EDT/1418 GMT from Thursday's 62.49 real close after local newspapers reported the funds managed by Banco Garantia bank and BEA Capital bought the stake comprised of preferred shares.
TAM said it had no official available to comment on the report.

Gazeta Mercantil said the funds are betting on the company's growth given that air traffic in this continent-sized country is modest and has room to expand. They are also counting on TAM's performance within the Brazilian air carrier market.
The paper said the number of Brazil's air passengers relative to its population is low compared to other countries in the region of comparable per-capita income levels.
